kronecker.note: [category, a, n, (a | n), shift]: the symbol from an independent computer algebra system, shift = a random offset s with rowReducer(a - s, n).symbol(s) = (a | n)

rowReducer.note: symbols[r][k] lists kronecker(x0[k] + i, rows[r]) for i = imin .. imax as characters - 0 +

shapes.note: [g, area, genus] of S_g and Z_g

lehmer.note: xorshift32 state at the start of the pair generator, the number of pairs, and the sha256 of the lines category|a|n
